data: How many different syntactic functions are represented in the study?

The figure is a t-SNE visualization of syntactic differences across multiple languages, with each point representing a syntactic function. The legend on the left side of the figure lists the different syntactic functions, which are represented by distinct colors. Counting these colors, there are 11 different syntactic functions listed: advmod, amod, case, cc, conj, det, mark, nmod, nsubj, obj, and obl. Therefore, the number of different syntactic functions represented in the study is 11.
